name: cms-content-agent
description: AI content & SEO agent for WordPress: a self-hosted backend running Claude Code / Codex / agy plus a WordPress plugin with chat in wp-admin, a review queue and a "Write with AI" block-editor sidebar.

scripts.check: node --check server/*.mjs server/store/*.mjs bridge/*.mjs bridge/adapters/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs dev/*.mjs web/widget.js wordpress/content-agent/assets/editor.js
scripts.lint:php: for f in $(find wordpress -name '*.php'); do php -l "$f" > /dev/null || exit 1; done && echo php ok
